brief:
Israeli forces have shut down all crossings in the occupied West Bank, the Wafa news agency reported. The move amounts to a comprehensive closure of the territory's entry and exit points.

Restrictions have been tightened around Ramallah, with roads and entrances to several towns and villages sealed off, according to Middle East Eye's account of Wafa's reporting. The scope and duration of the closure were not immediately specified.
dek: 'Comprehensive closure': Israel to shut down all West Bank crossings, Wafa reports Israeli forces have tightened restrictions around the occupied West Bank city of Ramallah, closing roads and entrances to several towns and villages, Wafa news agency reported.
title: Israel closes all West Bank crossings in comprehensive restriction
